title: Qascade: gradient boosting of small quantum convolutional neural networks
description: Qascade is a Python library for gradient boosting of small quantum convolutional neural networks (QCNNs), with a scikit-learn API built on Qiskit primitives. It implements Friedman-style functional gradient boosting in which each weak learner is a small parameterised quantum circuit, and it works with a built-in exact simulator or any Qiskit Estimator V2 primitive. It reports circuit cost in hardware-equivalent circuit executions so that training budgets can be compared. It makes no claim of quantum advantage.
